name: Agent CLI Permissions
description: Inspect canonical .agents/permissions/*.yml CLI command rules (DENY > ASK > ALLOW), test commands against permission groups, and sync them into the native permission formats of compatible AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and more).

cover.alt: Agent CLI Permissions: two-tier permission governance for AI coding agents, with the DENY > ASK > ALLOW precedence chain and target agent names.

screenshots.alt: The panel showing 207 rules across the company baseline and project tiers, colour-coded allow or deny and grouped by permission set.
screenshots.caption: Browse every rule across company baseline and project tiers, resolved by DENY > ASK > ALLOW.

screenshots.alt: The panel in the Orca sidebar with a command tester, governance badges for remote policy, auto-sync and git gate, and an Enforce button.
screenshots.caption: Test commands, watch governance status, and Enforce hooks right from the Orca sidebar.
